activity_summary: At dusk you spoke to the ceiling. A crack in the plaster had the shape of the Thames, and you named Blackfriars and the Bridge along it. You cannot lie on a floor in London. You have a king to bury.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said it to the ceiling, low, and stopped.

entities.name: the king in the cut play
entities.context: Mentioned in A crack the shape of the Thames

facets.activity: Named the Thames, Blackfriars and the Bridge in the crack

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: There's a crack in the plaster the shape of the Thames. Blackfriars. The Bridge.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I can't lie on a floor in London. I've a king to bury.
